item.title: Welcome to Phoenix Finance Decentralized Leveraged Token Trading Competition.
item.dc:creator: Crypto Michele
item.content:encoded:
Welcome to Phoenix Finance Decentralized Leveraged Token Trading Competition. May the best trader win!

Phoenix Finance is organizing the first Decentralized Leveraged Tokens Competition from Oct 21 to Nov 4. This will be a chance for talented traders to win tens of thousand PHX in prizes and show off their abilities!

The results will be calculated by using on-chain addresses and compared off-chain.

Total rewards: 200,000 PHX

  • 1st 100,000 PHX
  • 2nd 50,000 PHX
  • 3rd 10,000 PHX
  • 4–30th 1,500 PHX

Where:

https://app.phx.finance/leveraged

Competition Period:

From October 21 at 14:00 UTC to November 4 at 14:00 UTC.

Rules:

  • Through the portal above, users can choose to participate in the competition through Polygon, BSC or Wanchain. The performance will be ranked on the three chains together.
  • There is no need to sign-up. All addresses are automatically qualified, as long as they meet the following requirements.
  • Traders must use new empty addresses to participate and initial funds should be deposited before the start of the competition. Transfers and interactions with contracts other than the Phoenix Finance contracts will be deemed invalid.
  • Addresses failing to make any transactions will also be seen as invalid.
  • The minimum requirement for an initial deposit is $300. Participants can choose one cryptoasset among USDC, USDT, BUSD, wBTC, ETH, WAN whose value will be recorded using the current price when the competition starts. Addresses with multiple currencies will be deemed invalid.
  • The upper limit is not capped.
  • Please note that there will be gas costs associated with transactions.
  • Participants may trade decentralized leveraged tokens on any underlying asset. There is no limit to the amount or times of transactions.
  • The ranking will follow the rate of return in the individual address at the closing time of the competition. Positions not closed will not be taken into calculation.
  • Results will be disclosed 7 days after the closing time and rewards will be transferred to the relative addresses.

Welcome to join in the competition and win rewards!

item.title: QuickSwap Launches PHX Syrup Pool
item.dc:creator: Crypto Michele
item.content:encoded:

This pool will enable holders of dQUICK — the staked form of QuickSwap’s own token, the QUICK — to earn extra yields in PHX.

Needless to say, this will enlarge the pool of users who are already part of our community and boost the visibility of Phoenix Finance, while QuickSwap’s token will get yet one more use case.

To learn more about Syrup Pools and how they work, please follow this link.

The team would also like to remind our users that another pool is already active on QuickSwap, powered by the PHX/MATIC pair and providing rewards in QUICK. An excellent opportunity to expand your portfolio!

item.title: PHX Listing, Farming and a Pool Coming to ApeSwap
item.dc:creator: Crypto Michele
item.content:encoded:
Dear community,

As Phoenix Finance strengthens its presence on the Binance Smart Chain (BSC) it is a pleasure to inform our community that on September 13:

  • PHX will be listed on ApeSwap on BSC
  • A farm and a pool will be launched on ApeSwap

This means that $PHX will now be listed on one of the most popular exchanges on BSC, boosting its appeal for new users, while the farm and pool will allow investors to reap continuous profits.

More specifically, investors will be able to stake PHX-BNB in the farm to earn ApeSwap’s native token BANANA. The latter, along with GNANA, another of ApeSwap’s tokens, can then be staked in a new single-asset staking pool to earn PHX rewards. (Up to $72k for 2 months.)

More details on the initiative will be shared as the launch date approached. Stay tuned!

item.title: Phoenix Finance Joins BSC Anniversary Celebrations with Sponsorship and a $2000 Airdrop
item.dc:creator: Crypto Michele
item.content:encoded:
Dear Community,

On August 25, Phoenix successfully launched on Binance Smart Chain, the third network on which we have deployed, following Polygon and Wanchain.

As committed partners, it is with pleasure that we announce Phoenix is about to take part not only in one but in two official events to celebrate BSC’s one-year anniversary.

First, we will be one of the official sponsors of “1 Year of BSC: Beyond the Big Bang”, the event scheduled for September 1st, 2021. As part of the plan, Changpeng Zhao, Binance’s CEO, as well as a number of experts from leading crypto projects will take part in a livestream discussion.

Phoenix is also joining another event organized by Binance along with SecondLive, with a dedicated boot inn all-crypto virtual hall. As part of the exposition, we $2000 worth $PHX will be airdropped to participants.

You are all invited to check the schedule, lineup and all other details on the Binance official announcement or directly on the event’s page.

Stay tuned for more news!

The Phoenix Team

item.title: Phoenix Finance Deploys on Binance Smart Chain. Find out all the details.
item.dc:creator: Crypto Michele
item.content:encoded:
Following our deployment on Polygon and Wanchain, it is a pleasure to announce to our community that we are launching on Binance Smart Chain (BSC) at 14:00 UTC 25th Aug 2021, bringing over our full suite of products — including mining, staking, boosting, options, and leveraged tokens.

For all those who are interested in the opportunities on offer, we would like to direct you to:

  • Our brand-new website: www.phx.finance
  • Our DApp platform: app.phx.finance

(Please remember that in order to operate our platform on BSC, you must first switch your wallet to the Smart Chain mainnet for operations.)

The contracts governing the functions below will start automatically as we launch and be immediately available to users.

Binance Smart Chain:

  • 3X Leveraged Tokens on BTCB and BNB — buy and sell
  • Options on BTC and ETH — buy and exercise
  • BUSD/USDT Pool for Options Mining — 6000 cPHX per day
  • BUSD Lending Pool for Leveraged Tokens Mining — 4000 cPHX per day
  • BTCB Lending Pool for Leveraged Tokens Mining — 2000 cPHX per day
  • BNB Lending Pool for Leveraged Tokens Mining — 2000 cPHX per day
  • Pancakeswap PHX/BNB LP Mining — 12000 cPHX per day

Please note that the daily mining has been increased compared with the original announcement.

In the first two weeks, there will be caps in the leveraged tokens pools. This will serve to curb any unexpected risk as we launch this innovative product and help protect both our users’ interests and Phoenix Finance’s reliability.

  • BUSD pool: 1,000,000 BUSD for the pool and 100,000 BUSD for each address.
  • BTCB pool: 16 BTCB for the pool and 1.6 BTCB for each address.
  • BNB pool: 1,250 BNB for the pool and 125 BNB for each address.

For further details concerning our protocols and mining system, as well as the Peckshield audit report of our leveraged token contract, please see below:

  • Mining rewards each day for each pool, pls check the article: https://medium.com/phoenix-finance/phoenix-finance-launch-plan-216db01bc05e
  • Mining and boosting mechanism pls check the link: https://docs.phx.finance/mining/mining/
  • Papers for Leveraged Token and Options please check: https://docs.phx.finance/about/productpaper/
  • Audit reports, pls check: https://github.com/Phoenix-Finance/Pdfs
